name: mirage
text: Correction to what I said before: the cards in your screenshots were the Kalshi bets in the main list, not old ones. The main list was always ordered by EV, and the sort buttons hid whenever Novig had no bets of its own. I've fixed that: the buttons now show whenever any bet is listed, and Stars and Soonest order Kalshi and Novig bets together. I'm adding the same Best EV / Soonest / Stars buttons to the CNO scanner now, and both will ship in one release.
